title: Ferwater Clover
body:
Description

The Ferwater Clover is a massive four-leaf clover that only spawns in the grass of Ferwater Island. It is just like Finlay Clover, but it has a slightly brighter tint of green, and has less spawn area as Ferwater island is mainly desert and the Ferwater Clover only spawns on grass.

The Ferwater Clover was previously a limited time tree that would only spawn during the Saint Patrick's Day event. However, it now is permanently obtainable in lower quantities except for during the event.

Trivia

  • Similar to Mushrooms, the clover's leaves disappear when sanding them.
  • As of version v.1.54.0 (04/14/24), the tree was brought back to permanently stay in the game.
